claims.claim: The European Space Agency is developing Argonaut to deliver cargo and technology to the Moon starting in 2030.
claims.episode_span: The European Space Agency is developing Argonaut to deliver cargo and technology to the Moon starting in 2030.
claims.source_title: Europe Building Lunar Capability with Argonaut Mission from 2030
claims.supporting_quote: Europe is building its own capability to reach, land and operate on the Moon. Bringing together expertise from across Europe, Argonaut will deliver cargo and technology to the lunar surface, starting with its first mission from 2030.

claims.claim: Hera fired its thrusters for 31 minutes yesterday, cutting its speed by 70 m/s at a distance of 2300 km from the Didymos-Dimorphos system.
claims.episode_span: Hera fired its thrusters for 31 minutes yesterday, cutting its speed by 70 m/s at a distance of 2300 km from the Didymos-Dimorphos system.
claims.source_title: Hera Mission Completes Successful Braking Manoeuvre
claims.supporting_quote: Hera’s second braking manoeuvre yesterday proved successful, reducing the spacecraft’s velocity relative to the Didymos and Dimorphos system by 70 m/s from a distance of 2300 km away. Some 90% of the 31-minute thruster firing took place in the early morning.

claims.claim: In the deepest region of Earth's mantle, just above the core, much of the material consists of crystals of magnesium oxide.
claims.episode_span: In the deepest region of Earth's mantle, just above the core, much of the material consists of crystals of magnesium oxide sitting under pressures equivalent to the weight of the entire atmosphere pressing down on every square centimetre of surface.
claims.source_title: A mineral from the inside of planets reveals a surprising lesson: How you push matters
claims.supporting_quote: In the deepest region of the Earth's mantle, just above the core, much of the material consists of crystals of magnesium oxide.
